user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point layer into the census tract coordinate reference system so the spatial join can be performed with compatible CRS definitions.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer from its known source CRS EPSG:4326 to the explicit target CRS EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially join each reprojected hospital point to the census tract containing it and return the tract identifier with the hospital attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join using the reprojected hospital points as the target layer and the census tract polygons as the join layer. Retain each hospital record and append the containing tract identifier from the tract GEOID field.
